---
title: "Contact / Kontakt"
---

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  document.querySelector('.lang-de').style.display = 'none';
  document.querySelector('.lang-en').style.display = 'block';
});

function switchLang(lang) {
  document.querySelector('.lang-en').style.display = 
    lang === 'en' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.querySelector('.lang-de').style.display = 
    lang === 'de' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.lang === lang);
  });
}
</script>

<div class="lang-toggle">
  <button class="lang-btn active" data-lang="en" 
  onclick="switchLang('en')">EN</button>
  <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="de" 
  onclick="switchLang('de')">DE</button>
</div>
```

::: lang-en

I welcome enquiries from researchers, clinicians, and members of the 
public. Please see below for how to get in touch.

**Email**  
[valeska.kozik@med.uni-jena.de](mailto:valeska.kozik@med.uni-jena.de)

**Address**  
Universitätsklinikum Jena  
Klinik für Neurologie  
Am Klinikum 1  
07747 Jena, Germany

**Types of enquiries welcome:**

- *Study participation:* if you are interested in taking part in one 
of the research studies, please visit the 
[Participate / Teilnehmen](participate.qmd) page for more information.
- *Professional collaboration:* I am happy to hear from researchers 
and clinicians interested in collaborative projects.
- *Questions about my research:* if you have read about one of my 
studies and would like to know more, please don't hesitate to 
get in touch.
